title: High-score Worker operations
description: The routes the Rally Worker answers; everything else under its route is a static asset.

entities.name: Open the game
entities.description: The game's page, for players who are signed in.
entities.authorization: Signed in to icelander.net with the games:play role (AUTH.requireRole).
entities.result: The page from the static assets, marked Cache-Control: private, no-cache.
failures: Signed out: a redirect to /auth/sign-in that returns to the same address afterwards.

entities.name: Issue a match's seed
entities.description: Starts a one-player match that may later enter the table.
entities.authorization: Signed in to icelander.net with the games:play role (AUTH.requireRole, with api: true).
entities.result: { id, seed }: a new random id and 32-bit seed, stored as unused. Unused seeds older than 24 hours are deleted on the way.
failures: Not signed in, or without the role: the sign-in library's refusal.

entities.name: Submit a match
entities.description: Puts a finished one-player match on the table, after replaying it.
entities.authorization: Signed in to icelander.net with the games:play role (AUTH.requireRole, with api: true).
entities.result: The seed is marked used and the replay's score stored under the cleaned name; returns { score, rank, name }.
failures: Not JSON, or a bad game id, name or level: 400.
A seed that is unknown, used or older than 24 hours: 409.
Moves that do not replay a whole match: 422.
Not signed in, or without the role: the sign-in library's refusal.

entities.name: Read the table
entities.description: The best ten matches, as JSON for the game's own table.
entities.result: { scores: [{ name, score, level, mine, theirs, won }] }, best first, ties oldest first.

entities.name: Show the scores page
entities.description: The best 25 matches as a web page in icelander.net's look.
entities.result: An HTML page with names escaped; /games/retro/rally/scores redirects to it with 301.

relatedViews.relationship: The use case that calls them.
